principle: The MCP front door stays small and workflow-oriented; depth lives in the implementation layer (runbook v3.0 §9.17 SMALL SURFACE, §2.2 Salt DS precedent). Exactly 5 visible tools.

tools.name: get_project_context
tools.description: Return the canonical project context: the design-core package identity, the canonical token source (tokens.dtc.json), the component registry source (componentDefs.ts), the MCP surface spec, and the fail-closed rules (unknown inputs never guess). Single call to orient any agent before composing against canon.

error.message: get_project_context: could not read project context (internal error)

tools.name: resolve_token
tools.description: Resolve a single design token path to its CSS custom property and resolved value, following {ref} indirections. Example: resolve_token("color.accent.default") → "--p31-color-accent-default: oklch(65% 0.18 195)".

error.message: resolve_token: unknown token path "..." — refusing to guess; consult list_tokens (implementation layer)

tools.name: get_component_schema
tools.description: Return the full contract for a P31 component: CSS class, category, tokens used, props, slots, variants, accessibility requirements, status, and tier. An uncontracted component does not exist for the agent.

error.message: get_component_schema: unknown component "..." — an uncontracted component does not exist for the agent

tools.name: resolve_device_tier
tools.description: Resolve the P31 delivery tier for a web-capable surface from capability input (never device brand). Width class per Material 3 (<600 compact, 600-839 medium, >=840 expanded); pointer/hover are independent capability flags, surfaced never collapsed. Unknown capability values fail closed.

width_dp.description: CSS viewport width in dp (e.g. window.innerWidth)

error.message: resolveDeviceTier: pointer must be one of "none" | "coarse" | "fine" | "mixed", got "..." (unknown capability — refusing to guess)

tools.name: get_tier_tokens
tools.description: Return the frozen device-tier manifest object for one tier (the contract values: windowSizeClass, pointer, hover, touchTargetMin, navigation, delivery, safeAreaInsets, embedded budgets). Unknown tier names fail closed.

error.message: getTierTokens: unknown tier "..." — valid: embedded, mobile, tablet, desktop (refusing to guess)
